## Line 768

```plato

    // The incenter: the point equidistant from all three sides (the center of the
    // inscribed circle), the vertex average weighted by opposite side lengths.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incenter#Cartesian_coordinates
    Incenter(t: Triangle2D): Point2D
    {
        var a = t.B.Between(t.C).Magnitude;
        var b = t.C.Between(t.A).Magnitude;
        var c = t.A.Between(t.B).Magnitude;
        var sum = a + b + c;
        return ((a * t.A.X + b * t.B.X + c * t.C.X) / sum,
            (a * t.A.Y + b * t.B.Y + c * t.C.Y) / sum);
    }
```
